aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Snapdeal implementation — Full Settlement Financial Summary
filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where runtime supplies it.
formula_sql:
SELECT
  type,
  COUNT(*) AS records,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_gmv,
  SUM(commission) AS total_commission,
  SUM(courier_fee) AS courier_fees,
  SUM(closing_fee) AS closing_fees,
  SUM(marketing_fee) AS marketing_fees,
  SUM(payment_collection_fee) AS payment_fees,
  SUM(discount) AS discounts,
  SUM(cash_discount_adjustment) AS cashback_adj,
  SUM(tax_igst_amount + tax_cgst_amount + tax_sgst_amount) AS gst_on_fees,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settled
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY records DESC;
